title: Data Warehousing: BigQuery & Looker — Failure Injection & Auto-Healing
purpose: Simulates Slot Saturation & Dynamic Reservation Autoscaling: unexpected concurrent ETL burst saturates 2,000 baseline slots; BigQuery Edition autoscaling allocates burst capacity.
routing_rationale: BigQuery Editions (Standard, Enterprise, Enterprise Plus) support dynamic slot autoscaling, seamlessly absorbing analytical query spikes without queueing delays.

nodes.label: 50 Heavy Concurrent SQL Queries
nodes.detail: End-of-month financial reconciliation queries run concurrently with marketing ETL.

nodes.label: Slot Utilization Sentinel
nodes.detail: Queries begin queuing; execution wait times climb from 2s to 45s.

nodes.label: Enterprise Slot Autoscaler
nodes.detail: Automatically expands reservation pool from 2,000 to 3,500 slots in 10 seconds.

nodes.label: Queued Queries Complete
nodes.detail: All 50 queries execute in parallel; slots scale back down to 2,000 when workload clears.

steps.title: Saturation Detection
steps.action: BigQuery detects query queue depth increasing and requests additional slots.
steps.why_traversal: Prevents business-critical reporting deadlines from being missed.

steps.title: Elastic Slot Scaling
steps.action: Pool expands to 3,500 slots; queries finish in parallel; costs scale down automatically.
steps.why_traversal: Balances high performance during peaks with cost predictability during idle periods.

scenarios.label: Hard Max Slots Cap Causes Indefinite Queueing
scenarios.root_cause: Administrator set max_slots cap to 2,000, preventing autoscaler from expanding.
scenarios.diverted_path: Executive dashboard queries queued for 45 minutes during board meeting.
scenarios.recovery: Increase max_slots limit on Enterprise reservation or create dedicated high-priority reservation pool for Looker.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.
